facts.fact: Sienna POV epilogue：Peyton 被捕——五项谋杀+纵火+电信诈骗+挪用公款（把和解金塞进自己口袋），她建了一整套建立在谎言上的骗局。
facts.anchor: Five counts of murder. Arson. And that’s just the beginning.

facts.fact: 终极揭示：Milo 已经死了——死于纸厂火灾；Max 在精神病院「和 Milo 说话」是在跟他死后的灵魂/幻影说话。
facts.anchor: Milo’s dead, Doctor. He’s been dead for almost eleven years now.

facts.fact: Milo 救了 Max——把她推离爆炸最严重的地方，自己承受了最重的烧伤。
facts.anchor: The only reason her entire body wasn’t burned to a crisp is because Milo pushed her away from the worst of the blast

facts.fact: Max 父亲的死因：听说女儿死了——心脏衰竭而死，「死的时候都不知道她活了下来」。
facts.anchor: Max’s dad wasn’t so lucky. When he heard about the fire and thought his daughter had been killed, his heart gave out.

facts.fact: Milo 的死因：在医院撑了很久——听到 Max 活了下来，他放手了；「他一直在等她安全的消息」。
facts.anchor: The moment Milo heard Max was going to be okay, his heart stopped beating.

facts.fact: Sienna 的判词：他最终成为了他一直承诺要成为的人——她无法自救时救她的人。
facts.anchor: he’d become exactly what he’d always promised to be. The person who saved her when she couldn’t save herself.

facts.fact: 全书最后一句：不是所有爱情都有圆满结局——但那不代表它们不非凡。
facts.anchor: Not all love stories end with a happily ever after, Doctor. Doesn’t mean they’re any less extraordinary.

facts.fact: Sienna 对医生说：Max 不是在跟自己说话——是在跟 Milo 说话；Milo 已死但对她来说从未离开。
Sienna 在停车场注意到一个可疑男人（Elias from Blackwater Falls）——为续集埋伏笔。
facts.anchor: This man has blood on his hands.
